results.title: N. Ram on his interview with Sonia Gandhi
results.content: N. Ram reflects on his interview with former Congress president Sonia Gandhi, who discusses her upcoming memoir, Belonging: A Journey of Love. She speaks about the impact of twelve years of BJP-RSS rule on Indian democracy, defends the Congress party’s fight for a level playing field and shares how her love story with Rajiv Gandhi evolved into a lifelong commitment to India.

results.title: India offers to mediate Russia-Ukraine food corridors ahead of peace talks
results.content: India has offered to mediate between Russia and Ukraine to establish food corridors. Following a telephone conversation with Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy welcomed the offer. The diplomatic outreach comes ahead of fresh Russia-Ukraine peace talks in Abu Dhabi.
